goal: Make agent-kit's change record check trustworthy now that it is enforced and runs from the base branch: a VERIFIED claim must cite a real file, and a pull request must not be able to make the check read files outside the repo.
changed: debrief.py check reads a claim's record as a literal path that must name one regular file git tracks or has staged; a pathspec pattern, a folder, a symlink or a submodule is refused.
debrief.py refuses to read a change record that is a symlink, resolves outside the repo, is not a regular file, or that git holds with a mode other than 100644.

claims.claim: The CLI rejects records of '*', ':(glob)**' and ':/', and refuses a symlinked record and a link to /dev/zero without reading them, where origin/main's script passed the patterns, printed the linked file's version and keys, and hung on /dev/zero
claims.check: repro.sh (in the record) runs origin/main's debrief.py and this branch's against the same scratch git repo on macOS, Python 3.9, with a 10 s alarm
claims.remaining: Not run on the Linux GitHub runner itself; the unit tests cover the same cases there

claims.claim: The stricter rules change nothing for quality, finances and agent-ledger: old and new checker print identical output on their local checkouts
claims.check: debrief.py check --root <checkout> with origin/main's script and this branch's, outputs diffed
claims.remaining: Local checkouts, which may lag their remotes; quality and finances each have two records that fail on both versions

claims.claim: The full suite passes, including five new tests that fail on origin/main's script

next.item: Move the debrief.py pins in quality, finances and agent-ledger to this commit
next.why_now: They run the check from pinned older commits, so they keep both holes until the pin moves
next.impact: Their change record checks stop accepting pattern records and stop reading symlinked records

next.item: Fix the two failing records each in quality and finances (VERIFIED without commit or record)
next.why_now: Found while checking the downstream repos; they fail on old and new checkers alike
next.impact: Those repos' full record check goes green

next.item: Refuse a .changes folder that is a symlink to another folder in the repo, and stop debrief.py new writing through a dangling symlink
next.why_now: Review of this fix found both; neither is reachable from a pull request's added records
next.impact: Closes the last ways a record path is not what it looks like
